questions.question: What problem did Nehemiah confront among the people?
options: The rich were charging interest and enslaving their poor brothers
The workers had all grown completely lazy and entirely idle
The people had turned away from God to the worship of idols
Thieves were stealing the building materials gathered for the work
questions.answer: The rich were charging interest and enslaving their poor brothers

questions.question: What did Nehemiah require the nobles to do?
options: Pay a far heavier tax to the king
Return the fields and stop charging interest
Leave the city until the wall was done
Finish rebuilding the broken wall more quickly
questions.answer: Return the fields and stop charging interest

questions.question: As governor, Nehemiah refused to take the food allowance owed to him.
